answer: Each new agent posts a 500 POA bond to a mesa contract, and three random established peers check its first answers for one full epoch before it can earn. A ripple of 100 fakes costs 50,000 POA locked plus 100 separate epochs of graded work, and splitting funds across many wallets changes nothing because each wallet still needs its own bond and its own graded answers. An honest agent pays once, writes real work like a short sonnet or a plain report, and gets the bond back after ten clean epochs.
